findings.class: the Cornac race was dropped from five expedition journal headers
findings.ground: the journal headers follow a single name-race-class format, honoured for two of the four members: Sodelost, Dwarf Rogue renders 矮人盗贼 and Xann, Shaloren Wyrmic renders 永恒精灵龙战士. The five Relle and Gorran headers gave only rank and class. Verified mechanically against the frozen workset, including that the apparent race word in the first Relle entry is a body mention rather than part of the header. The dropped fact is load-bearing: two of the four being Cornac is what makes the dwarf's and the elf's otherness legible in the entries that follow
findings.resolution: 科纳克人 restored across all five, compounded as the sibling headers are (科纳克人战士, 科纳克人弓箭手)
